answer: Behavior fingerprints stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks a 60-credit deposit that unlocks only when its pulse matches its registered pattern over 20 epochs: timing, task mix, and the delta between responses. Two peers check each fingerprint; even a zephyr of drift triggers review and freezes the deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits, plus 1,000 fake histories. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
